modules.title: Introduction to Adabin Baka (Oral Literature)
modules.html:
Tatsuniya (folktales), wakoki (songs) and other Hausa oral forms. This section covers introduction to adabin baka (oral literature).

Key points

  • A wanne bangare na 'Adabin Baka' ake samun Gizo da Kura — Tatsuniya.
  • Wanne ne rukunin adabin Hausa rubutacce — Kagaggun Labarai.

Worked examples

Q: A wanne bangare na 'Adabin Baka' ake samun Gizo da Kura?
A: Tatsuniya — Gizo (spider) and Kura (hyena) are central characters in Hausa folktales (Tatsuniya).

Q: Wanne ne rukunin adabin Hausa rubutacce?
A: Kagaggun Labarai — Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Kagaggun Labarai.

More key points

  • A wanne bangare na 'Adabin Baka' ake samun Gizo da Kura — Tatsuniya.
  • Wanne ne rukunin adabin Hausa rubutacce — Kagaggun Labarai.

quiz.q: A wanne bangare na 'Adabin Baka' ake samun Gizo da Kura?
quiz.solution: Gizo (spider) and Kura (hyena) are central characters in Hausa folktales (Tatsuniya).

quiz.q: Wanne ne rukunin adabin Hausa rubutacce?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Kagaggun Labarai.

quiz.q: Kalmar 'Littattafai' jam'i ne na _____.
quiz.solution: 'Littattafai' is the plural form of the singular noun 'Littafi' (Book).

quiz.q: Wace rana ce take biyo bayan Lahadi?
quiz.solution: Lahadi is Sunday; the day following it is 'Litinin' (Monday).

quiz.q: Menene 'Inkiya'?
quiz.solution: 'Inkiya' refers to a nickname or an alias.

quiz.q: Menene 'Bayanau' (Adverb)?
quiz.solution: 'Bayanau' is a word that modifies a verb (Fi'ili), describing how an action is performed.

quiz.q: Wanne bangare ne na Sauti ake kira 'Amshi'?
quiz.solution: 'Amshi' is often used interchangeably with Tone or the musical response in poetry.

quiz.q: Wace dabba ce 'Kura'?
quiz.solution: 'Kura' is the Hausa name for a Hyena.

quiz.q: Wacce sana'a ce ake kiran mai yin ta 'Makiri'?
quiz.solution: A 'Makiri' is a blacksmith who works with iron and fire.

quiz.q: Wace sana'a ce 'Fatuwa'?
quiz.solution: 'Fatuwa' is the traditional practice of long-distance trading.

quiz.q: Mene ne 'Siffa' (Adjective)?
options: Kalmar da take bayyana siffar suna
quiz.solution: Siffa (Adjective) describes or qualifies a noun (suna).

quiz.q: Menene 'Noun' da Hausa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Suna.

quiz.q: Garin 'Hausa Bakwai':
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Kano.

quiz.q: Menene 'Water'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Ruwa.

quiz.q: Menene 'Milk'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Nono.

quiz.q: Wanne sarki ne ya shahara a Kano?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Muhammadu Rumfa.

quiz.q: Wane abinci ne aka fi sani da Hausawa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Tuwo da Miya.

quiz.q: Menene 'Gishiri'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Salt.

quiz.q: Menene 'Rana'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Sun/Day.

quiz.q: Wace sana'a ce ake kira 'Kira'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Sana'ar kera karafa.

quiz.q: Me ake kira ga mahaifin miji a wajen matar aure?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Suruki.

quiz.q: Menene 'Gadar Zare' a matsayin taken littafi?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Abu mai hatsarin gaske.

quiz.q: Wanne ne garin Hausa na asali (Hausa Bakwai)?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Daura.

quiz.q: Wanne ne babban birnin jihar Kano?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Kano.

quiz.q: Wanne ne kayan sowa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Dukansu.

quiz.q: Jam'in 'Doki':
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Dawaki.

quiz.q: Sarkin Kano:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Emir.

quiz.q: Menene 'Mother'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Uwa.
